fact: The Togo government ICT specifications guide states Togocom has deployed a backbone of about 1,500 km north to south on the axes Lome-Atakpame-Cinkasse, Lome-Kpalime-Atakpame and Lome-Aneho, 24 fibres per link, doubled around Lome and on Atakpame-Kara and Kara-Cinkasse; no date given for deployment, so the document's published date 2023-02-20 is used.
